scope: Native owned-PC ordinary cast map/active-prerequisite/non-consuming item gates; source rejection ordering and timer side effects.

source_authority.contract: Ordinary cast checks source wMapID against owning player map, except INVALID_MAPID, before resource/prerequisite/reuse gates.
MP then HP (strict HP > cost), CheckPrevAct(wPrevActiveID), CanUse, SkillUse, then UseSkillItem. Unsuitable weapon retains already-armed own and same-kind timers without HP/MP deduction.
Loop has different ordering and uses wTargetActiveID; no normal map restriction or timer arming on unsuitable weapon rejection.
UseSkillItem handles reagents/cash/ammunition and first matching powered equipment. CheckPrevAct searches maintained effects, never learned skills.
SkillUse arms the own cooldown and extends all learned same-kind peers.
Original wPrevActiveID, wTargetActiveID, wMapID and item/weapon column mapping.
Original result codes NEEDPREVACT=10, UNSUITWEAPON=9, WRONGREGION=17.

implementation.hydration: Fresh and transferred native hydration load wPrevActiveID and wMapID with unsigned WORD conversion; source -1 remains 0xffff. Existing per-character equipment eligibility is shared by normal and repeated casts.
implementation.authority: Existing ready-primary operation fence, owned PC, exact channel/map, learned rank, and full packet parsing remain required.
implementation.ordering: Ordinary region, MP, HP, previous active prerequisite, cooldown, then item eligibility; live timer arming on supported unsuitable weapon follows original SkillUse ordering. All checks and mutations share the character lock.
implementation.effects: An unbuffed graph with a required previous active effect returns NEEDPREVACT, even if that skill is learned. Buff-backed prerequisites await authoritative effect lifetime and close before mutation.
implementation.unsupported: Ordinary casts now also refuse unsupported reagent/ammunition/cash inventory branches before any timer/resource change. This deliberately preflights unsupported work before the source side effect, rather than acknowledging a free cast.
implementation.wire: Existing CS_SKILLUSE_ACK, LOOPSKILL_ACK and HPMP layouts unchanged. Rejections never deduct HP/MP or emit HPMP; supported ordinary weapon rejection alone arms its source timers.
implementation.migration: No new migration. Backups and applied migrations 001-021 retain hashes; next is 022.

wire_fixture.skill_1329: Requires map550; synthetic native caster is in source fallback map0.
wire_fixture.skill_736: Requires maintained skill733. Both are learned only on a disposable character; no effect is fabricated.

pinned_content.note: All source charts are read-only. Only synthetic learned rows/resource values in the owned test DB are seeded.

regression_before.expected_failure: Native skill wire: ordinary cast outside source map550 returns original WRONGREGION
regression_before.scope: Previous installed loop daemons; current mounted backend executable. Old runtime accepts the source map550-only skill in map0.

targeted.scope: Plain/encrypted actual dispatch, normal-vs-loop gate selection, same-kind timer side effects, learned-vs-maintained prerequisites and unsupported state drain.

limitations: Only native owned-PC casts. Monster/recall, replica gameplay and the old no-payload path are not extended.
Reagent/ammunition/cash transactions, durability consumption, premium medal costs, toggle effects and active buff lifetimes remain unported.
Non-consuming item eligibility is cached; equipment/skill mutation must rebuild it. Out-of-range source bit shifts remain unsupported.
Cancellation requires authoritative cast lifecycle. Damage, powers, full target/action/peace-zone/tournament rules, multi-hit expansion and AOI remain incomplete.
No original client executable was run; network tests use source-derived encrypted synthetic peers.
